csv_agency: City of Wilmington Div Of Procurement & Records
csv_scope_of_work: Architectural Services. Advertisement - The City of Wilmington, Department of Real Estate and Housing, is seeking Requests for Qualifications RFQs from experienced architectural firms to provide professional architectural services. The selected firm will serve as the prime consultant and will be responsible for assembling and managing a comprehensive design team. This team is expected to include, at a minimum, civil engineering, geotechnical services and other necessary disciplines to support the successful planning, design, and execution of assigned projects.
